card.name: Wildlife and roadway text, linking words
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'wild', 'between', 'of', 'the' and the 'is' in Canis, inside passages about wild animals (boar, buffalo, turkey, coyote) or freeway lanes.

modes.label: Wild animal passages
modes.description: Fires on 'wild' or on the 'is' in Latin genus names like Canis in species lists.
modes.example: jackal can<<is>> aurea, genet Genetta gen

modes.label: Freeway lane wording
modes.description: Fires on linking words in text about managed freeway lanes.
modes.example: The distinction<< between>> managed lanes and other traditional forms of freeway
